newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy to issue new CCTs and 3-yr BTPs in Q2.
newsitem.headline: Italy to issue new CCTs and 3-yr BTPs in Q2.

text.p: The Italian Treasury said on Monday it would offer a new issue of three-year fixed rate bonds (BTP) and a new issue of floating rate seven-year certificates (CCTs) during the second quarter of 1997.
It said it would issue a minimum 10 trillion lire of the new BTP paper, dated May 15, 1997 and a minimum 10 trillion lire of the new CCTs, dated May 1, 1997.
In addition, the Treasury said it would re-open existing issues of five, 10 and 30-year BTPs. The 30-year paper would only be offered at the first paper auctions of the month.
The Treasury statement said in the first half of April, it would issue a minimum eight trillion lire of new issue 18-month zero couponed bills (CTZ) dated April 15.
It said it would re-open the March 14 1997, 24-month CTZ at the start of April and would offer a new issue later in the quarter.
